name: com.tridentstack/docs
title: TridentStack Control Docs
description: Search and read TridentStack Control documentation: patching, vulnerabilities, compliance, API.

tools.name: search_docs
tools.description: Full-text search over TridentStack Control's customer documentation (guides, API reference, changelog, roadmap). Returns ranked results with titles, URLs, and snippets. Use this first to find relevant docs, then get_doc to read one in full. It also covers reference formats, including the Endpoint Checks import file format, so an assistant can write a check file a customer imports. Before writing or making calls to the TridentStack Control REST API, search for "API rate limits and efficient polling": it explains which endpoints answer a question in the fewest requests and how to handle a 429.

tools.name: get_doc
tools.description: Return the full markdown of a single documentation chunk by its id (from a search_docs result). Only ids present in the index are valid; this never fetches arbitrary URLs.

id.description: A doc id from search_docs, e.g. guide:rings#phases

tools.name: list_docs
tools.description: List the documentation catalog (id, title, source, url), optionally filtered to one content type. Use to browse structure before searching.
